summary: Sardis Escrow is an instruction-only skill that drives the Sardis escrow REST API (https://api.sardis.sh/v2) with curl and jq to create, fund, confirm, release and monitor USDC escrows on Base. It needs the SARDIS_API_KEY bearer credential, the curl and jq binaries, and wallet IDs for buyer and seller. It also lists an unpinned npm install of @sardis/sdk. The release metadata is stated to declare no env, although the SKILL.md frontmatter lists SARDIS_API_KEY, so the two disagree. The calls move real-value funds and the skill has no approval gates.

findings.message: SARDIS_API_KEY is listed in the frontmatter, but the release's declared requires.env is empty, so the credential the skill needs is not reflected in the release metadata.
Setup tells the operator to export SARDIS_API_KEY=sk_..., a secret that is then sent as a Bearer token in every call.
The API key authorizes fund and release operations on buyer and seller wallets (wallet_buyer123 and similar), so it is a wallet-controlling credential, though no raw private key or seed is requested.
Escrow, wallet, amount and delivery-proof data plus the bearer key are sent to api.sardis.sh, the only host the commands call.
The frontmatter installs the npm package @sardis/sdk without a pinned version, and no instruction in the skill uses it.
The skill card admits that live fund, release, refund and auto-release actions on real-value payments have no approval gates or safety limits.
The inspect header marks the release Security SUSPICIOUS with warnings, while the moderation status above it reads CLEAN.
